description: Original dinosaur-unicorn princess, powerful flyer, digger, runner and carrier of riders.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: transparent PNG character illustration for the MyStarQuest dinosaur collection.
Primary request: Faithfully redraw the child's invented DINOSAUR–UNICORN PRINCESS from reference image 1 in the polished rounded 3D cartoon style of this project's existing dinosaur artwork (reference images 2 and 3). She is the kind princess of all the other dinosaurs, a very powerful flyer, an excellent digger and runner with strong hind legs, and large and sturdy enough to carry people or tiny Teeniepings on her back.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the authoritative character design; follow its colours and distinctive features. Image 2 (Digosaurus) and image 3 (pink T. rex) are rendering/style references only, not the character to copy. This is the cartoon portrait, not a scientific reconstruction.
Preserve design: friendly pale cream face with a softly rounded dinosaur muzzle, one eye winking and one large glossy dark eye with little lashes, cheerful open smile; pink swept forehead tuft and pink nape frill; a SINGLE upright tapered unicorn horn with coloured rainbow rings and a dark teal tip; a small GOLD PRINCESS CROWN with a heart-shaped red/pink jewel nestled beside/behind the horn as drawn. Preserve the sweeping rainbow colours: bright pink wing tips with broad orange, golden yellow, turquoise, blue and purple bands flowing toward the body; blue upper chest, warm red/coral lower torso, pink lower body, and a large clear PINK HEART marking on her side. Preserve turquoise, mint green and yellow sections along the upper back/nape. Pink powerful hind legs with purple/rainbow lower-leg accents and pale cream three-toed dinosaur feet with sturdy digging claws.
Form and abilities: make her clearly a friendly fantasy dinosaur with a unicorn horn, substantial rounded dinosaur body and two powerful muscular hind legs, not a horse or a human. Give her TWO exceptionally LARGE, broad, beautifully structured colourful wings with generous flight surface, recognizably following the drawing's rounded tips and gently scalloped lower edges. Wings rise and spread out from the shoulders in a strong flight stroke. Small front dinosaur paws are visible near the chest, matching the drawing. The back is broad and gently level between the shoulders and hips, visibly sturdy enough to comfortably carry riders. A modest smooth dinosaur tail can follow the body's direction if needed for balance, but keep the drawing's overall shape and main features. No saddle needed. No riders or other characters in this standalone portrait.
Pose/composition: one complete character, graceful diagonal flying pose inspired by the drawing, head toward upper left, torso sweeping to lower right, both strong hind legs trailing but clearly separated, front paws gently reaching forward. A slight three-quarter turn allows the pink heart marking, strong hindquarters, back and crown to be seen. Wings take up a substantial portion of the image and look powerful rather than tiny decorative fairy wings. Whole horn, crown, both wingtips, tail and feet fully in frame with generous 5–8% clear margins. Use a landscape or square canvas suited to the wingspan.
Style: match the existing dinosaur assets' high-end family animation 3D rendering, soft rounded sculpted volumes, subtly pebbled skin, gentle material texture on wing membranes, soft studio lighting, rich vivid colours, warm approachable expression, polished readable silhouette. Crown is softly gleaming gold. Maintain the drawing's imaginative design and colour blocking while cleaning up sketch ambiguities.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, isolated character, no ground or cast shadow. No photographed paper, desk, pencil strokes, text, labels, watermark, frame, other dinosaurs, humans or Teeniepings.
correctionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this exact unicorn-dinosaur princess illustration, preserving her identity, pose, colours, crown, rainbow unicorn horn, face, wink, enormous rainbow wings, small front paws, pink heart marking and the two strong rainbow-accented hind legs.
REQUIRED ANATOMICAL CORRECTION: There are two proper hind legs at the bottom, with rainbow feather cuffs and cream clawed feet. KEEP BOTH of those unchanged. The long pink appendage extending from her rump toward the far right is her TAIL, but it incorrectly ends in a THIRD cream clawed foot. Remove that entire cream foot and reshape only that appendage into a clean, smooth, tapering pink DINOSAUR TAIL with a pointed pink tip. The tail must look unmistakably like a tail, with no toes, claws or cream projections. Result has exactly two hind feet, two small front paws, two wings and one smoothly tapered pink tail.
Also ensure a clean genuine transparent alpha background outside the character with NO coloured halo, glow, vignette or backdrop. Preserve the character's existing soft 3D lighting and colours. Keep all extremities fully visible and add modest transparent margins if needed. No other design changes.
